rows.text: [Per Sandy Brondello] Per Sandy Brondello, Sabrina Ionescu remains OUT tonight against the Valkyries.
rows.name: Per Sandy Brondello

rows.text: Tash is still day-to-day with the nose fracture.
rows.name: Sandy Brondello

rows.text: Sandy Brondello doesn’t expect there to be minute restrictions for Natasha Cloud and Isabelle Harrison today.
rows.name: Sandy Brondello

rows.text: That's obviously promising with her history, so it's a day-to-day.
rows.name: Sandy Brondello

rows.text: Again, based on what Sandy Brondello said today, the expectation is that JJ is good to go tomorrow.
rows.name: Sandy Brondello

rows.text: Sandy Brondello said that this is precautionary, and the Liberty play Thursday, Friday, and Sunday.
rows.name: Sandy Brondello
